title: Restaurant Management SaaS
oneLiner: An online and offline POS for the whole restaurant.
description: A full-stack online and offline point-of-sale and operations platform covering end-to-end restaurant workflows, with offline-first sync and a single management dashboard. Built at OranetAI.
points: Offline-first sync so service never stops.
One dashboard for the entire restaurant.
Built from scratch with Node.js, React and SQL.

title: NFT Minting Platform
oneLiner: Gas-efficient ERC-721 and ERC-1155 minting with upgradeable contracts.
description: ERC-721 and ERC-1155 contracts using OpenZeppelin and Beacon Proxy for gas-efficient upgrades, with a wallet-connect minting flow and a Web3 frontend, tested with Truffle and Hardhat.
points: Beacon Proxy upgrades keep gas costs low.

title: Decentralized Escrow
oneLiner: Trustless payments between buyers, sellers and arbitrators.
description: A smart-contract escrow system that holds funds until both sides are satisfied, with an arbitrator to settle disputes.
points: Funds locked on-chain until release conditions are met.

title: NFT Certificate
description: A web app that issues certificates as NFTs, so anyone can verify who earned what without trusting a middleman.
points: Certificates minted on-chain and verifiable by anyone.

title: Online IDE
oneLiner: Write code in the browser and run it on the cloud.
description: An online IDE that sends your code to a Google server to execute and returns the output in the browser.
points: Run code remotely, no local setup.
Output returned straight to the editor.

title: ChatGPT Chrome Extension
oneLiner: Select any text on any page and get a ChatGPT answer.
description: A Chrome extension that fetches ChatGPT responses for selected text on any webpage, with click-to-copy answers.
points: Long questions are truncated for readability.

title: ZebraSwap DeFi DEX & AMM
oneLiner: AMM logic, liquidity pools and yield farming for a DEX.
description: Core DeFi protocol components for a decentralised exchange: automated market maker logic, liquidity pools, yield-farming strategies and cross-chain integrations, with an emphasis on secure on-chain execution.

title: PolluxChain & Polink Wallet
oneLiner: A Layer 1 blockchain and the wallet that makes it usable.
description: Architected a Layer 1 blockchain and built the backend for Polink, its native crypto wallet: high-throughput services with Redis for caching and job queues, secure wallet APIs and Solidity smart contracts.
points: High-throughput backend with Redis caching and queues.

title: AI Customer-Support Chatbot
oneLiner: Best Chatbot Hack, sponsored by Travelers.
description: A conversational LLM assistant with intent handling and context-aware responses, with an NLP/LLM backend wired to a React frontend for real-time chat. Won Best Chatbot Hack.
points: Real-time chat on a React frontend.

title: Google Cloud AI App
oneLiner: Best Google Cloud Hack for AI-driven features and clean architecture.
description: A cloud-native application built on Google Cloud AI and ML services. Won Best Google Cloud Hack for its AI-driven functionality and clean cloud architecture.
points: Built on Google Cloud AI/ML services.

title: CRONIX Staking dApp
oneLiner: A staking dApp with wallet connect and validator views.
description: A Vite, React and TypeScript staking dApp with Home, Staking and Validators pages, RainbowKit wallet connection and light and dark themes.
points: Wallet connection with wagmi and viem.
Mock adapters ready to swap for real chain APIs.

title: JARVIS Virtual Assistant
oneLiner: A Stark-style desktop assistant powered by multiple LLMs.
description: An Electron and Python virtual assistant with a futuristic HUD interface that routes requests across multiple LLM providers.
points: Electron desktop app with a custom HUD.

title: Payment Withdrawal Module
oneLiner: Secure and scalable withdrawals for a payments system.
description: A Node.js and TypeScript backend module for secure, scalable payment withdrawals, backed by MongoDB and Mongoose.

title: Nexus Graph
oneLiner: Find who in an org can help, and how to reach them.
description: A graph-backed expert and collaboration finder on CognoDB (openCypher over Bolt) with skill search, shortest introduction paths and team building.
points: Skill Finder reaches people within two introductions.
Path Finder returns the shortest chain between any two people.
Team Builder assembles the smallest team covering required skills.

title: Crypto Flow Radar
oneLiner: A Binance perpetuals scanner with trend confirmation.
description: A scanner for Binance perpetual futures with trend confirmation, an EMA screener, sector flow and fair-value-gap levels.
points: Scans perpetual markets for confirmed trends.
EMA screener and sector flow views.
